fonts.name: Instrument Serif
fonts.usage: Hero headlines, large manifesto numbers, major section titles. Use italic selectively for emphasis.

fonts.name: Noto Serif Devanagari
fonts.usage: For the word 'प्रोडक्ट' in the headline to match the serif elegance of the Latin display font.

fonts.name: Manrope
fonts.usage: Nav links, tagline, marquee text, small metadata.

rules.headings: text-6xl md:text-8xl lg:text-9xl tracking-tighter leading-[0.9] font-normal. Scale extremely large for hero.
rules.numbers: Massive scale (text-5xl to text-7xl) for manifesto chapters, styled distinctly, often overlapping elements.

background.description: Off-white, paper-textured feel. Never pure white. Creates the magazine page baseline.

text.description: Deep charcoal for stark contrast. Never pure black. Softens the harshness while keeping edge.

accent.description: A sharp vermilion/burnt red for subtle interactive highlights, hover underlines, or tiny geometric shapes.

visual_enhancers.texture: Add a subtle SVG noise/grain overlay across the entire page (opacity ~3-5%, mix-blend-mode: multiply, pointer-events: none) to enhance the print/editorial vibe.
visual_enhancers.borders: Use hairline borders (1px solid #121212 with 10% opacity) for structural divisions, mimicking magazine grid lines.
visual_enhancers.photography: Strictly Black & White with high contrast. Use a 'clipped frame' (e.g., an arched top `rounded-t-full` or precise rectangular CSS clip-path) with a subtle spotlight effect.

layouts.navigation: Sticky top nav, using the primary background color to prevent text overlapping issues. Use shifting underline hover micro-interactions on links.
layouts.hero: Kinetic layout. Large Devanagari-blended headline spanning the screen. Tagline and portrait placed asymmetrically to create tension.
layouts.marquee: Slow, smooth-running editorial text ticker placed strategically (e.g., separating the hero from the manifesto sections).
layouts.manifesto: Numbered chapters (01, 02, 03) arranged in an asymmetrical bento-style or wide-column layout.

motion.hero_reveal: Masked line-by-line reveal: Wrap each text line in an overflow-hidden container and animate the text upwards (y: '100%' to '0%') over 1-1.5s with a custom cubic-bezier.
motion.scroll: Smooth momentum scrolling enabled via Lenis wrapper.
motion.image_parallax: Subtle parallax on the hero image via Framer Motion useScroll hook (moving slightly slower than the page scroll).
motion.interactions: Nav links and buttons should have premium micro-interactions.

hero_portrait.treatment: Convert to grayscale via Tailwind `grayscale contrast-125`. Place inside an explicit clipped frame.

components.name: NoiseOverlay
components.instructions: A fixed absolute div covering the screen with pointer-events-none and a noise texture background.

components.name: KineticHeadline
components.instructions: A framer-motion powered component that splits the text into lines and animates them up from behind a mask on mount. Headline text: 'Turning user problems into प्रोडक्ट that matter'.

components.name: EditorialMarquee
components.instructions: Uses react-fast-marquee to display the role keywords / manifesto slogan continuously at a very slow speed.

components.name: ClippedPortrait
components.instructions: Image component using CSS clip-path or rounded-t-[50%] structures, applying the B&W filter and Framer Motion parallax.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text contrast against the #F4F4F0 background exceeds WCAG AA standards.
accessibility.motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion media query to disable Lenis and Framer Motion transforms.
accessibility.test_ids: Apply data-testid attributes to all interactive elements, e.g., data-testid='nav-about-link', data-testid='hero-contact-button'.

instructions_to_main_agent: Read this JSON and implement a highly polished magazine-style editorial portfolio landing page.
Use standard React .js files, NOT .tsx files. Use standard DOM and Tailwind classes.
Inject fonts via standard Google Fonts link tags in the main index.html or import in CSS.
Integrate the Hindi text 'प्रोडक्ट' fluidly within the headline using the 'Noto Serif Devanagari' font.
Do not build out the full internal pages for About, Experience, Contact—just use anchor links or teased sections below the fold.
Implement the framer-motion line-by-line reveal exactly as described.
Provide a smooth smooth-scrolling experience using Lenis.
Ensure the hero image uses the provided URL and is treated with high-contrast grayscale.
Never use pure white #FFFFFF or pure black #000000.
Install necessary dependencies: yarn add framer-motion lenis react-fast-marquee lucide-react clsx tailwind-merge
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Don't make generic centered layouts. Use asymmetrical alignments, empty space, and dramatic typographic scales.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Never use placeholder URLs (like via.placeholder.com). Use only provided media URLs.
Include data-testid on every interactive element.
